items.text: 5% graphene-reinforced PET-G filament designed for demanding technical applications requiring enhanced mechanical strength and durability.
For parts exposed to environmental conditions
If your print will contain moving parts
When you care about time & speed of print
If you want great properties for good price
If you care about mechanical properties
If you care about how the printout presents
If you care about the quality of the printout
It is designed for engineering and industrial applications.
This makes the filament more resistant to stress and ideally suited for advanced technical applications.
Prografen PET-G Graphene Strong is a perfect choice for printing parts that require high mechanical strength, such as functional prototypes or spare parts.
Thanks to its wear resistance and low abrasion, it can be also suitable for printing gears or guides.
Its excellent dimensional stability and fast printing capabilities make it an ideal choice where precision and speed are essential.
Enriching PET-G with graphene makes this filament ideal for a wide range of demanding applications.
This filament has been developed in response to market demand for a professional material that, despite its high mechanical strength, allows effortless printing at high printing speeds.
Tensile strength 25% higher than pure PET-G.
Stiffness (Young's modulus) 20% higher than pure PET-G.
Ability to print faster while maintaining the same nozzle temperature with respect to pure PET-G.
Possibility to print at a lower temperature while maintaining the same speed with respect to pure PET-G.
Resistant to environmental conditions and many chemicals.
PET-G PROGRAFEN GRAPHENE STRONG is easily processed on FDM/FFF 3D printers.
This high-performance filament is characterized by exceptional mechanical strength, wear resistance and low abrasion.
Prografen PET-G Graphene Strong offers significantly improved mechanical properties compared to pure PET-G.
Its tensile strength is 25% higher and its stiffness (Young’s modulus) is increased by 20%.
Additionally, the flow rate (MFR) is 170% higher than pure PET-G, enabling high-speed printing while maintaining excellent print quality.
Ability to print faster while maintaining the same nozzle temperature with respect to pure PET-G
Easy to print
Resistant to environmental conditions and many chemicals
The material exhibits minimal shrinkage allowing for extremely good dimensional stability of the printed parts.
Reduced shrinkage compared to pure PET-G.
Its significant advantage of PETG is practically no shrinkage, odorlessness & chemical resistance.
Post-treatment Painting, smoothing
Drybox recommended: No
In addition, the material does not require special nozzles or climate chambers.
Extrudability with standard nozzles without the risk of excessive wear in contrast to carbon fiber materials.
If you want to print with standard nozzle
Low abrasion means the filament can be easily printed using standard brass nozzles without the risk of excessive wear, unlike materials reinforced with carbon fibers.
Can be extruded with standard brass nozzles without the risk of excessive wear in contrast to carbon fiber reinforced materials
Ruby or hardened nozzle recommended: No
* If you don’t need fast printing, you can lower the extrusion temperature (relative to the same material without graphene), thus saving energy.
Enclosure not necessary
Adhesive not necessary (for increased adhesion or to prevent warping: Dimafix, 3DLac, Magigoo)

Prografen PET-G Graphene Light is a graphene-enhanced filament for 3D printing, designed for everyday engineering and industrial applications.
Prografen PET-G Graphene Light differs from the Strong version by its lower graphene content (0.5% compared to 5%), making it the ideal choice for less demanding applications.
Enriching PET-G with graphene makes this filament ideal for a wide range of applications.
It contains 0.5% edge-functionalized graphene flakes (EFG), which gives it better mechanical strength compared to standard PET-G, while maintaining ease of printing and low abrasion.
The small amount of graphene enhances the filament’s strength, flexibility, and wear resistance, making it more durable than traditional PET-G filaments.
